answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, slashed on a failed audit. The island lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the reef is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sonnet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
